lines.t: Verse 1
I don’t wanna walk this line
Half alive, half resigned
Calling faith what’s cold inside
Keeping comfort as my guide
I have seen the drifting start
Slow decay within my heart
Trading fire for control
Letting distance take its hold
Pre-Chorus
I bring it all into the light
Every shadow, every compromise
Chorus
I won’t hide behind the lie
I won’t keep this part alive
Take this heart, crucify
What resists and will not die
When I fall, I will return
Trusting mercy I don’t deserve
You are faithful, You remain
Calling me to life again
Verse 2
I have stumbled, I have strayed
Turned from what Your Spirit said
Still Your voice is calling me
Back to truth, back to peace
Not by strength that I can claim
Not by will or empty name
But by grace that pulls me through
Teaching me to follow You
Pre-Chorus
I lay it down, no holding back
No more walking off that path
Chorus
I won’t hide behind the lie
I won’t keep this part alive
Take this heart, crucify
What resists and will not die
When I fall, I will return
Trusting mercy I don’t deserve
You are faithful, You remain
Calling me to life again
Bridge (build)
Make my love be more than words
Let it live in all I do
If I love You, I will obey
Let my life be proof of truth
Strengthen me where I am weak
Lead me where I cannot see
Form in me a faithful heart
Make me wholly set apart
Final Chorus
I won’t hide behind the lie
I won’t keep this part alive
Take this heart, crucify
What resists and will not die
When I fall, I will return
You are grace I have not earned
I am Yours, so lead me on
Till my will and Yours are one
Outro (soft)
No more drifting, no delay
I choose life, I choose Your way
